description: This Java class implements a mini-language operation called 'FieldToResult', which transfers the value from a specified field to a result map within a method execution context. It is part of the Apache OFBiz framework's mini-language processing for simple method operations.

classes.name: FieldToResult
classes.description: Implements a mini-language method operation that maps a field's value to a result key within a method context. It handles attribute validation, nested expression evaluation, and supports dynamic field and result names.

classes.name: FieldToResult.FieldToResultFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToResult from XML elements within the mini-language framework.

methods.name: FieldToResult
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML element attributes, validating input and setting up flexible map accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation by retrieving the field value from the environment map and storing it into the results map, with support for nested expressions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation, mainly for debugging.
